runs.text: In year 37, early winter, morning, at Harum, the winter camp of the Kesh band, Imra was shaping a scraper by striking cutting stone against a lump of heavy yellow stone. Sparks fell on dry moss beside Imra, and the moss began to smoke. Imra blew on the smoking moss, and it caught fire. Imra tried again three times that day, and the moss caught fire two of those times. Tavu saw it. The Kesh band kept fire only by carrying embers from camp to camp before this. Imra believed fire lives inside the heavy yellow stone.

This was the first time anyone in the world made fire by striking stones. Imra believed fire lives inside the heavy yellow stone.

Year 41, deep winter, night. At Harum, the old winter camp of the Kesh band, Oru, a man, 58 years old, of the Kesh band, died from cold. In autumn, Oru broke his leg in a fall, and after that Oru could not walk far. Food ran out at Harum, so the Kesh band moved to Ulmeke, their word, "red cliff", a camp 4 days' walk away. The band left Oru behind at Harum with a small fire and 2 strips of dried meat. Sefi, a woman, 34 years old, of the Kesh band, was the last to leave him. On his 4th night alone, the fire went out and Oru died of cold. Ten days later, 2 hunters of the band found his body beside the dead fire.

Year 52, spring, night. The Tulo band camped on the shore of Sefa. Kaya gave birth to a girl in the camp on the shore of Sefa. Anwe and Lisu helped her. The labour lasted most of the night. The girl was small, and she cried at once. The girl is the 2nd child of Kaya. The first, a boy, is 3 years old. The girl has no name yet. The Tulo band believed and was sure that a child is given a name only after it lives through its first winter.

Year 63, late summer, dusk. Anuk waited for Moro at Teshu, a ford of the river. When Moro came to cross, Anuk killed Moro with a spear thrust to the belly. The spear had a cutting stone point. Moro died at the ford before dark. Ishe saw the killing from the far bank. Ishe ran to the Tulo camp and told them. Anuk believed and was sure that Moro killed his brother Pell in the spring.

Year 70, autumn. At Ulmeke, a cliff with dry caves, the Amaru band, 26 people, argued for 2 days about where to spend the winter. Hesh wanted to go to Kotara. Nima wanted to stay at Ulmeke. The band split: 11 people went with Hesh to Kotara, and 15 stayed with Nima at Ulmeke. Rafi, the son of Hesh, stayed with Nima. Hesh believed and was sure that the shellfish at Kotara do not run out in winter. Nima believed and was sure that the walk to Kotara is too long for the old and for small children.

Eleven people went with Hesh to Kotara. Fifteen stayed with Nima at Ulmeke. Rafi, son of Hesh, stayed with Nima. Hesh believed shellfish at Kotara do not run out in winter. Nima believed walk to Kotara too long for old and small children.

In year 77, late winter, night, Dabo planned to cross the frozen lake Sefa to hunt on the far shore. The night before, Dabo dreamt that his dead mother Ama stood on the ice, and the ice broke under her. When Dabo woke, Dabo changed his mind and did not cross the ice. Dabo walked around the lake instead, which took him 2 days. That same morning, Pek and Hanu crossed the ice and came back safely. Before the dream, Dabo believed the ice is strong enough to cross. After the dream, Dabo believed the ice will break.

Ama stood on the ice. The ice broke under Ama. When Dabo woke, Dabo changed his mind. Dabo did not cross the ice. Dabo walked around the lake instead. This took Dabo 2 days. Pek and Hanu crossed the ice and came back safely that morning.

Year 118, winter, night. At the winter camp of the Kesh band in Harum, Shana told the story Tara-mi to 14 listeners. The story involved Imra, who first told it in year 45. The old telling stated fire lived inside the heavy yellow stone. Imra struck the stone, and fire jumped into the moss. The telling now stated the sky put fire inside the heavy yellow stone. The first mother struck the stone, and fire jumped into the dry grass. This change involved the sky being added as the one who put fire in the stone; the name Imra was lost, and she became the first mother; the moss became dry grass.

She became the first mother. The moss became dry grass.

Year 90, summer, afternoon. At Ulmeke, the camp of the Amaru band. During a storm, sky-fire struck a lone tall tree on the ridge above the camp. The tree split and burned. No one was hurt. Nima said the sky-fire was a sign that the dead no longer wanted the band at Ulmeke. Seventeen of the twenty people of the Amaru band came to believe her. Three days later, the band left Ulmeke and walked toward Sefa. Nima believed the sky-fire was a sign that the dead no longer want the band at Ulmeke. Seventeen of the twenty people of the Amaru band believed the same as Nima.

Year 95, late autumn, before dawn. The Tulo band camped on the shore of Sefa. Seven men of the Kesh band, led by Kelo, attacked the Tulo camp. Kelo killed Gudo with clubs. Rena and Oshi were taken captive, and their hands were tied with sinew cord. Rena and Oshi carried the dried meat of the Tulo band to the Kesh camp. The other Tulo people fled into the reeds. Kelo believed the Tulo camp had more dried meat than it needed.

Temo gave 3 lumps of red earth to Yari. Yari gave Temo a string of 12 white shells from Kotara. The two bands camped apart for 1 night and went their separate ways the next morning.
